sourceChecks.text: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He was with her hidden in the LORD’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the LORD’s house;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。
